title: Tabletop board height: post-hoc development amendment (the researcher, 2026-11-04)
made_after: inspecting the committed board-height scan results (results.json, decision.json, commit a63ad64 on branch tabletop). It is not the outcome of the predeclared rule.
decision_record: progress/DECISIONS.md, entry '2026-11-04 - Tabletop board height: development amendment after inspecting the scan (the researcher)' (the researcher's local notes, not in the repository)

original.outcome_note: verbatim from decision.json 'outcome'; the scan picked no height (H_T_m null, ind28_width_m null). The scan's committed outputs are unchanged by this amendment and stay the record, including the original statistical output (the per-cell Fisher p-values in decision.json).

amendment.ind28_variant: TABLETOP VARIANT 0.36 m wide x 0.18 m tall x 0.005 m thick (the physical IND28 is 0.28 m wide)
amendment.ycb_box_note: all four choices, as kept by the scan's own ycb_box rule (decision.json ycb_box: each admits >= 1 target); the class matrix decides the target lists
amendment.parking_note: the parked occluder's base centre inside the frame at >= 1 stop: the rule the scan already used (base_config.json occluder.parked.min_stops_in_frame = 1). Unchanged: the full footprint on the table (table_edge clearance), clear of the target and distractors, outside the target's context window at every stop, hiding nothing from any stop, and the parked-shadow nuisance control (light-centre screen + analytic area-light ray check).

reasons: Identity support and placement rates were conflated. The researcher's earlier wording did not separate target support (which identities can be placed) from placement success rates; the committed rule (b) added a statistical requirement comparing each target's count with its best cell across DIFFERENT IND28 widths. IND28's maxima are split across widths (soup 69 and meat 51 at 0.28 m; brick 90, tuna 87 and mug 30 at 0.36 m), so no single cell holds all five and no height could pass.
All five target identities are admitted at 0.18 m: S8, M16-L, M16-R and IND28 at both 0.28 m and 0.36 m (decision.json per_height['0.18']).

Within-width comparison: at IND28 width 0.36 m, 0.18 m has at least as many observed successes as every other scanned height, for every target (decision.json per_height[h].ind28_by_width['0.36']: soup 42 vs <= 14, meat 34 vs <= 14, mug 30 vs <= 12, brick 90 vs <= 84, tuna 87 vs <= 87).

IND28 width 0.36 m is chosen for the DESIGN-CASE GEOMETRY, not because its 0.18 m total (283) exceeds 0.28 m's (279): in the researcher's analytic check at 0.18 m the 0.28 m board cannot fully hide the design mug (nominal margin -48.762 px at P1/P5), while 0.36 m fits with a tight nominal margin of 3.435 px (gap 0.005 m, shift -0.02 m); at the fixed TDES3 revisit poses the analytic coverage stays >= 0.998 (P5 margin -3.5 px). Some sampled extreme revisit-box corners fall below 95 % (P1 96.9 %, P5 93.5 %); the rendered-mask check stays in place before the full batch.

Parking at >= 1 stop: requiring the parked object in every frame adds a restriction unrelated to the verification question (smoke runs on seeds 9900-9911, disclosed in scan_plan.json: an all-five-stops rule let 5 of 12 S8 parks succeed).
statistics_disclosure: The committed one-sided Fisher comparisons treat outcomes on the shared probe seeds 7000-7099 as independent samples; the cells are paired by seed, so a paired comparison would be needed.
A non-significant difference does not establish equivalent placement rates.
Each cell was compared with a maximum selected from the same scan (a sample-selected best).

This amendment therefore rests on the observed support (which identities are admitted) and on the design-case geometry, not on that test. The original statistical output is retained unchanged in decision.json.

evidence.note: the researcher's post-hoc review after inspecting the scan: analytic geometry only (convex-hull pinhole projections), no rendering, no policy result or test scene inspected; made at commit 1782efa. Copied unchanged (byte-identical, sha256 below) from the main checkout's gitignored runs/2026-11-03-tabletop-scan-review/ into posthoc_review/.
limitations: Analytic convex-hull pinhole checks only; exact rendered masks and pixels are not computed.
Sampled revisit-box corners are not a proof of a bound over the continuous revisit range (sampled minimum 93.5 % at TDES3 P5).
The design margin check uses nominal projections; the revisit check uses the fixed TDES3 revisit draws.
Rendered mask labels remain authoritative: the rendered-mask check stays before the full batch.
audit.json's recommendation uses descriptive per-seed results, not the scan's inferential gate.
Absolute paths inside the files (source_scan, python) are kept as written; they describe the researcher's machine when the checks ran.
